description.subtitle: Short pants of the first team Puma del Valencia CF 2025 2025 - black
description.tagline: Ligereza y orgullo valencianista en cada jugada
description.intro: This shorts from Valencia CF's first 2025/2026 equipment is made of high performance technical fabric, ideal to accompany you in trainings and matches. Its white design with black and orange details reflects the club's identity with elegance and functionality.
key_benefits: Official design: Part of the first equipment of Valencia CF 25/26.
Technical comfort: Light fabric that allows constant ventilation.
Optimum performance: Sport fit designed for fast movement.
Quality finishes: Elastic waistband and club heat transfer shield.
Modern aesthetic: Clean look that combines with the official shirt.
